title: Terminal: Integrations
summary: Bring records, guide pages, rewards, missions, and operations tabs into one console.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Wiki registers a Codex tab, Index can publish recipes, SignalOS can provide records, and TutorialCore can report terminal-opened progress.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Terminal with Wiki guide links, Index recipes, SignalOS records, MissionCore objectives, TutorialCore notices, and addon-specific operation tabs.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If a tab is missing, use the manual or source addon directly. Terminal should collect useful surfaces, not hide them.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
